svg.title: Fieldstone Crew stair flooring portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional flooring portfolio concept for Fieldstone Crew, showing precise hardwood stair treads and nosing. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
